items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I have a brother we just lost about a year or so ago. His name is Lucien Barberang.

ctx.x: Your father's name is? Is it John Barberang. How many brothers do you have?

I have a brother we just lost about a year or so ago. His name is Lucien Barberang. He died. And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson. His name is Lewis Barberang. Then I have another brother that plays a pretty good trumpet. But I don't know, he, he just rather work in there, before working in the daytime, and fooling with the trumpet, I guess, I don't know. I don't understand him. His name is Willie Barberang. He doesn't play very…
